# pve_sdn_ipam (Resource)

Manages an SDN IPAM plugin object (`/cluster/sdn/ipams`). The IPAM tracks IP address allocation for SDN zones and vnets. Changes stay pending until the `pve_sdn_apply` action runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An IPAM plugin tracks IP address allocation for SDN zones and vnets.
# Run the `pve_sdn_apply` action afterwards to activate pending changes.

resource "pve_sdn_ipam" "netbox1" {
  ipam  = "netbox1"
  type  = "netbox"
  url   = "https://netbox.example/api"
  token = var.netbox_token
}

variable "netbox_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipam` (String) The SDN IPAM object identifier (2 or more characters, starting with a letter). Changing this value forces recreation.
- `type` (String) IPAM plugin type. Must be one of: `netbox`, `phpipam`, `pve`. Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint of the IPAM server, as 32 colon-separated hex pairs.
- `section` (Number) phpIPAM section identifier (phpipam only).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token for the IPAM server (netbox and phpipam only).
- `url` (String) URL of the IPAM server (netbox and phpipam only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing SDN IPAM plugin by its identifier:
terraform import pve_sdn_ipam.netbox1 netbox1
```
